title: Known-object test, TOI-2876.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2876.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, recovered (4 covered epochs). Residual screen: 20 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 1 light curve(s), forming 5 distinct event(s), 2 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460679.5101 (ΔT 13.72 d); 1 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
